Name: LTCN_Name
Description: Indicates if the route is final or draft (see Endorsed field).
Possible Values: Draft LTCN Ð is not endorsed by the Local Government Final LTCN Ð is endorsed by the Local Government

Name: Route_ID
Description: Identifier for a route within the network.

Name: Hierarchy
Description: The function of the route within the network. For a description of the functions see: WA Cycling Network Hierarchy (transport.wa.gov.au)
Possible Values: Primary Route (1) Secondary Route (2) Local Route (3) Transport Trail (formerly named Tourist Trail) (4)

Name: LGA_Name
Description: Name of the Local Government Area.

Name: Endorsed
Description: Indicates if the Local Government has endorsed the draft LTCN at Council.

Name: Date_Endor
Description: Date of endorsement by the Local Government.

Name: Shape_Leng
Description: Length (m) using MGAz50 on GDA2020 datum
